items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Frank Rehak, yes, of course, and several others. ... we had people come through the band like Kai Winding and people like that.

ctx.x: Frank Rehak, yes, of course, and several others.

Yeah, you've been very fortunate. I notice, too, whether this is valid or not, but in judging a lot of jazz festivals the last three years, I think it's rather clear there's a dearth of fine trombone players.
